conviction_note: The one measurable thing the H1 release adds is whether the company holds its FY OP plan of ¥946m. IFIS consensus is ¥755m (ordinary profit ¥745m, unchanged for 4 weeks), about 20% below that plan, and Q1 ran ahead of plan (OP ¥240m, 25.3% progress, which the company called 'above plan'). So holding the plan reads as a modest relief. Against that, I have no Q2 data, revenue has to ramp hard (Q1 ¥2,116m against a ¥10,000m plan), and a crowded margin long caps the upside. That gives p_up 55 on a 6.5% scale, +0.65. The findings sum to +1.5 because the guidance finding is sized on its own and carries its full value if the plan is held; the scaled number keeps the uncertainty about Q2 revenue in p_up.
bar: FY27/2 company plan: revenue ¥10,000m, OP ¥946m, NP ¥663m, DPS ¥21 (Q1 決算短信, 2026-07-14, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592370.pdf). IFIS consensus (kabuyoho, as of 2026-10-13): revenue ¥9,582m, OP ¥755m, ordinary ¥745m, NP ¥529m (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9168). Coverage is one analyst (Okasan, 強気, TP ¥500). print_vs_bar_pct is my estimate of H1 OP against the path the street's FY ¥755m implies (about ¥172m a quarter for Q2-Q4, against a Q2 I expect nearer ¥200-230m). It is low-confidence because I found no Q2 datum.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position ≥0.5%, as of 2026-09-29, per baseline). The name is 信用 only, not 貸借, so no margin shorts are possible: margin sell balance 0, margin buy balance 1,169.9k shares on 10/09 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9168). That is about 4.7% of shares outstanding and roughly 20 sessions of the ¥22m/day median turnover. The buy balance peaked at 2.30m on 2026-01-23, after the January limit-down, fell to 1.50m by 07-17 and has kept falling (https://irbank.net/9168/margin). No skew exists. priced_lean_pct +0.024, run-up 20d -0.48%, 5d -0.24%: flat into the print.

findings.finding: The company's FY OP plan (¥946m) sits about 25% above the one-analyst IFIS consensus (¥755m OP, unchanged for 4 weeks), while Q1 OP of ¥240m was 25.3% of plan and 'above plan' per the company. Its plan implies only about ¥235m a quarter for Q2-Q4, so H1 most likely lands near half of plan and the plan is held, which reads as a relief against the street number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This stock moves hard on the guidance line. 2026-01-13, FY cut ('一転減益'): -17.75% and limit-down. 2026-04-13, FY27 guide of OP -44.5%: -16.49%. 2026-07-14, Q1 'ahead of plan' with the plan held: +4.79%. 2025-10-14, H1 plan held with a dividend raise: +2.77%. Holding the plan has been worth about +3 to +5; a cut has been worth about -17.
findings.why_not_priced: The street's own FY number (OP ¥755m) is below the company plan, so the price is set on the lower number. The stock trades at about 15x the company's EPS of ¥27.2 but about 19x a consensus-implied EPS near ¥21.7, which reads as the market not believing the plan. If the market expected the plan to be held, consensus would have moved up after the Q1 beat, and it has been flat for 4 weeks. Coverage is one analyst on a ¥10.5bn Growth name, so a held plan has few holders positioned for it.
findings.independence: The Q1 決算説明会資料 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593166.pdf) says OP was 'above plan' and revenue 'on plan'. Okasan raised its TP from ¥480 to ¥500 and kept 強気 on 2026-09-07 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9168&b=n202609070991). That is public and points the same way. The bar and the TP come from different sources; the Q1 progress comes from the company's own document.

findings.finding: The company's stated policy is a 総還元性向 of 30% or more, with buybacks 'continued opportunistically' (引き続き機動的な対応). The ¥378m Jan-Apr 2026 buyback is complete, cash stood at ¥1.98bn at Q1 end, and Arcus Investment raised its stake to 6.10% in June 2026, so a new 自社株買い announced in the same TDnet batch is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last H1 (2025-10-14) came with a ¥7 dividend increase and the stock rose +2.77% next session. The January 2026 buyback came with a profit cut and the stock went limit-down anyway. A dividend raise is not likely now, with payout already at 77.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing has been announced, and the company has given no signal of size or timing. The value is a low-probability event (I put it near 25-30%) times about +2 to +3 if it comes. Holders have not pre-bought it: the stock is flat over 5 and 20 days and the margin buy balance is falling.
findings.independence: Arcus Investment's 5% filings: 5.05% to 6.10% on 2026-06-03 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9168&b=n202606040855). This is a separate document that makes engagement for returns plausible but does not show it.

findings.finding: A margin buy overhang of 1.17m shares (about 4.7% of shares, about 20 days of volume), with no possible margin shorts on a 信用-only name, caps the squeeze-up and supplies sellers if the revenue ramp looks weak.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-01-13 cut the margin buy balance more than tripled (742k to 2.30m in two weeks) and the stock kept falling: -27% over two sessions and a further -16.5% at the April guide. That is the setup in which a disappointment still has sellers.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-13 (balances to 2026-07-17 on irbank; 10/09 balance 1,169.9k on https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9168)
findings.why_not_priced: Weekly margin data is public, so most of this is held by the price, which is why it is small. What is not priced is the asymmetry: with no short side, a bad Q2 revenue print finds leveraged sellers and no covering buyers.
findings.independence: This shares its source with positioning_check and nothing else.

outside_window.finding: Whether the FY revenue plan of ¥10,000m (+18.7%) is reachable depends on utilization recovering to the 90%s from 2Q onward (Q1: 86%, against a 92% plan) and on hiring senior consultants. A miss on that would show up as a later revision, most likely at the Q3 print in January 2027, the same quarter where the FY26/2 cut came.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: a cut at H1 is unlikely, since Q1 OP ran ahead of plan and the company's past cut came at Q3. Holding the plan against a street ¥755m is the base case and a mild relief; a cut is the tail (-15% history). Returns: no 増配 is expected at 77% payout; a new buyback is possible (policy is 'opportunistic', the prior program ended 4/30). New-year guide: none, this is H1. 進捗率: Q1 OP 25.3% and NP 30.9%, against a 4-year average NP progress of 22.8% at Q1 (kabutan). Revenue progress at Q1 was 21.2%, against 21.8% in FY25/2 (a growth year) and 26.2% in FY26/2.

baseline_tension: The baseline gives nothing to beat: the lean is +0.02, the run-up is flat and no short position is disclosed. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY plan against a street ¥755m, plus a possible buyback, and I looked for both: the plan's position against consensus is sourced, the buyback is not signalled. The strongest negative is a Q2 revenue stall with a margin-long overhang and no short side. A near-zero lean leaves the slight positive standing without disputing the price.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the margin-long overhang comes from weekly public data, so finding 3 was cut from -0.5 to -0.3.
Rule 1 / core 3a: the guidance finding was trimmed from +1.5 to +1.4. Its bar comes from a single analyst and I have no Q2 datum, so the size rests on an inference about Q2.
Rule 2 (check the sign; look for the strongest positive): I had already looked, and the draft leaned positive. p_up was left at 55, abs_move_pct at 6.5 and expected_move_pct unchanged.
